card.title: Reply to Anna re invoice timing
card.summary: Anna asks to pay the September invoice on the 20th instead of the 15th. The proposed reply agrees for September only.
card.body:
Anna (Nordic Supply) asks whether the September invoice can be paid on the 20th instead of the 15th.

## Proposed reply

> Hi Anna, the 20th is fine for September.
